assumptions.scope: One selected form, one successful print plus one retry. Budget assumptions, not a vendor quote or guarantee of friend's labor price. One kg covers two conservative solid-body prints with reasonable waste. Actual slicer reports supersede mass/time estimates.

sources.claim: Official category search returned standard 1 kg PETG listings at $25.49 sale; regional prices vary. Use $35/kg for conservative consumed-material budgeting, $45 delivered whole-spool allowance, not live checkout price.
PETG density 1.30 g/cm3 used as a conservative standard-unfilled-PETG mass assumption.
PETG functional use, material-specific print profile and suitable bed surface/release layer.
Perimeters and infill have different roles; 100 percent infill is usually unnecessary. Five walls/25 percent here are design choices, not manufacturer's certification of this tool.

approximate_print.method: Approximate cross-section integration: 5 x 0.45 mm walls, 1.2 mm skins, 25% infill. No printer toolpath/timing simulation.
